functionDeclarations.description:
Update the stay (check-in, check-out, party size) on the booking being modified.

Pass the FULL new stay even if only one field is changing - omit nothing.
functionDeclarations.name: set_stay

check_in.description:
New check-in date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format. May equal the
existing check-in (e.g. when the caller is in-house and just
wants to extend or shorten the check-out).
check_in.title: Check In

check_out.description: New check-out date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.
check_out.title: Check Out
